sloka: अरण्यां मथ्यामानायां प्रादुर्भूतो महातपाः ।मथनान्मिथिरित्याहुर्जननाज्जनको ऽभवत् ।यस्माद्विदेहात्सम्भूतो वैदेहस्तु ततः स्मृतः ।। ७.५७.१९ ॥
transliteration: araṇyāṁ mathyāmānāyāṁ prādurbhūto mahātapāḥ ।mathanānmithirityāhurjananājjanako 'bhavat ।yasmādvidehātsambhūto vaidehastu tataḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 7.57.19 ॥

translations.english: From the churned fire-stick, a great ascetic appeared, who was called Mithi because of the churning, became Janaka due to his birth, and was known as Vaideha because he was born from the bodyless Nimi.
